mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a comfortable temperature of 72 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under a Waning Crescent moon.

The Verona Public Works Department is hard at work maintaining our local streets, sidewalks, and utilities, and they encourage all residents to subscribe to the city newsletter to stay informed on these important infrastructure projects.

We have a busy schedule ahead! Today, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the downtown farmer's market returns to Hometown Junction Park, and you can also catch trivia at The Bogey Factory or enjoy pizza at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the police report from this week, on October 3, a 19-year-old was arrested after officers located him in a vehicle with expired registration, leading to the recovery of a stolen firearm.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
